name: Projected Positive Recursive Teaching Dimension
definition: The **Projected Positive Recursive Teaching Dimension** is $$\mathrm{RTD}^{+p}(\mathcal H)\bydef\max_{S\subseteq\mathcal X}\mathrm{RTD}^{+}(\mathcal H_{|S}),$$ where $\mathrm{RTD}^{+}$ is positive recursive teaching dimension.
graph_summary: Largest positive recursive teaching dimension attained by a coordinate projection.
description: The projection-monotonic closure of positive recursive teaching dimension.
origin_references: Database-defined projection closure of positive recursive teaching dimension, which is studied in \cite{fallat2023batch}.

monotonic.proof: For every coordinate set S, a trace of a subfamily is a subfamily of the corresponding trace. Positive recursive teaching dimension is subfamily-monotonic, and taking maxima preserves the inequality.

p_monotonic.proof: Every projection of a projection of H is already a projection of H, so the maximum over traces cannot increase after projection.

c_monotonic.proof: A conditioned fibre is a subfamily followed by a projection, so doubly monotonicity implies conditioning monotonicity.

doubly_monotonic.proof: The preceding subfamily and projection arguments establish both required forms.
